title: Benchmarking Deep Time Series Models for Equity Portfolios
summary: Benchmarking forecasting architectures for daily equity portfolios is not just a prediction exercise. It also asks which model remains usable after preferences, costs, and portfolio constraints are imposed. We build a CRSP daily-stock benchmark for 15 deep and statistical time-series architectures over 2018--2024. The protocol combines common-window decile portfolios, stochastic multi-criteria acceptability analysis, a deployment-adjusted acceptability index, and a constrained quadratic portfolio layer with capacity, beta, industry, risk, leverage, and turnover controls.
